CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid Docker templates maintained by jbat66. Layerling is a browser-based CAD application for 3D printing; its application and image are maintained by the upstream project at https://github.com/henmedia/layerling. Prusa Print Monitor is a PrusaLink printer dashboard for desktops, phones and room displays, with status alerts and an optional live camera. Report template and installation issues in this repository; application-specific support links are included in each template.
